deities: Sidh Baba Balak Nath Ji (incarnation of Shiva; also Peepal Mata shrine in the complex)

history.summary: Major pilgrimage cave temple at Deotsidh near Chakmoh village, Hamirpur district, dedicated to Sidh Baba Balak Nath, the child-siddh of the Nath tradition. The cave where he is said to have meditated enshrines a self-manifested idol installed, per tradition, by Baba himself; women view the cave from a raised platform opposite. The shrine is said to have grown from about 250 years ago into a major North Indian pilgrimage centre drawing devotees from HP, Punjab, Haryana, Delhi and abroad. CSV ERROR: the CSV 'state' column holds the town name 'Hamirpur'; the temple is in Himachal Pradesh.

name: Baba Balak Nath Temple, Deotsidh
town_description: Deotsidh is a hilltop cave-shrine complex at Chakmoh village, about 45 km from Hamirpur town near the Hamirpur-Bilaspur border. Devotees offer rota (sweetened wheat bread) on Sundays, and a ropeway connects nearby Shah Talai, another sacred spot 6 km away.

travel.airport: Kangra (Gaggal) Airport or Chandigarh Airport, then road
travel.road: About 45 km from Hamirpur by road; regular buses and taxis available

visitor_information.best_time: Chaitra Mela (March-April); Sundays draw large crowds year-round
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open daily throughout the year; exact darshan hours not verified in sources (verify)
